test_time_range_basic: test the pl.time_range function to generate a sequence of time values between start and end
test_time_ranges_eager: test the pl.time_ranges function with eager evaluation to generate time ranges from series inputs
test_time_range_interval_closed: test the pl.time_range function with custom interval and closed interval parameter
test_time_range_broadcasting: test the pl.time_ranges function with column and scalar broadcasting in dataframe expressions
test_time_range_equality_edge_cases: test edge cases of pl.time_range when start equals end, start is after end, or interval is invalid
